body.pairing: nearest strictly preceding radio row in same capture; conflicting rows at same seq -> NULL; no interpolation

body.sql: SELECT s.*,t.capture_id,t.status FROM task_sample s JOIN task_run t ON t.id=s.task_id WHERE t.project_id=:pid AND t.operator=ANY(:operator) AND t.tech=ANY(:rat) AND t.task_type=:type ORDER BY t.capture_id,s.seq
